caption:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] <Picture 1> shows an egocentric overhead view of a white square panel fastened with round metal bolts at its corners, lying on a dark speckled floor mat, with a light wooden box that has a small label on its front face and a pale patch on its top surface sitting at the center of the panel, and the person's black-socked feet and gray-clad legs visible at the bottom edge. At 0.00 seconds, the left hand, coming from a blue sleeve at the lower left, holds an orange squeeze bottle with an open green flip-top cap in the air above the wooden box, while the right hand is open with fingers spread at the lower right, touching nothing. In the later frames, both hands first hold the bottle upright above the box; then the right hand alone holds the bottle tilted up and away from the box while the left hand opens beside the box; then the right hand places the bottle upright onto the top of the box while the left hand touches the near corner of the box; then the left hand holds the bottle standing on the box while the right hand touches the right side of the box; and finally the left hand lifts the bottle off the box and tilts it horizontally above the box while the right hand is open beside it.
